title: 3rd trial journalist Ahmad Fauzi
paragraphs: The 3rd trial for spreading lies against newspaper reporter Borneo Raya, Ahmad Fauzi, has been published.

According to the charges, Ahmad Fauzi published a report about the death of a patient in a local hospital on August 11, 2025, a prosecutor's assessment of false information that caused havoc. The chapter used: section 28 verse (3) ITE Act (fail information).
The trial was held at the Pontinak State Court on January 28, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the hearing to February 25, 2026.
In the matter of Ahmad Fauzi, legal power of Joseph Maulana states that his client had been arrested 120 days and that period exceeded normal limits.
Ahmad Fauzi worked as a newspaper reporter for Borneo Raya at Pontianak, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The D.A. will read the charges to the next trial, Ahmad Fauzi is still in custody.
